question: Is PRFM Fitness suitable for beginners?
answer: Absolutely. Our programs range from beginner through to advanced, with experienced coaches to guide you along the way.

If you're stepping into a gym for the very first time, PRFM Base and PRFM Build are great places to start. They're designed to help you build confidence, develop good training habits, and create a solid foundation before progressing further.

question: How do I know which PRFM program is right for me?
answer: We recommend starting with a free consultation. We'll have a chat about your goals, training history, any injuries, and what you're looking to achieve, then help you find the program that's right for you.
You're also welcome to explore the program descriptions and sign up yourself. But in our experience, most people find that initial conversation incredibly helpful.

question: What equipment will I need?
answer: Equipment requirements vary depending on the program you choose.
Generally speaking, a regular gym or functional fitness facility will have everything you need. Each program has its own equipment requirements, so you can check these before getting started.

question: Can I follow PRFM alongside my current training?
answer: Potentially, yes.
While every PRFM program is designed to be followed as written, our training can also work well alongside other sports and general fitness routines.

You just need to be a little tactical about how you structure your week, particularly when it comes to recovery, overall training load, and avoiding doubling up on the same muscle groups back-to-back.
If you're unsure, have a chat with one of our coaches and we'll help you work it out.

question: What if I can't complete a workout as prescribed?
answer: This is one of the things that really separates PRFM from other online training programs.
Every exercise has a video demonstration with built-in scaling options, allowing you to adapt the session to your current ability.
You can easily see easier and more advanced variations of each exercise, making it simple to regress or progress movements whenever needed.
The goal is to keep you training with purpose, regardless of your current fitness level.

question: Will I have access to a coach if I need help?
answer: Absolutely.
Every PRFM program gives you the ability to message a coach directly through the app. We're also always happy to answer questions via email.
PRFM Custom takes things a step further, with 24/7 messaging access to your assigned coach for personalized guidance, feedback, and support.

question: Can I change programs after signing up?
answer: Absolutely. You're free to cancel your current program and sign up for another on the same day.
Your training should evolve as your goals change, and we don't want you feeling locked into something that no longer suits you.
If you're unsure which program to move to, just reach out and we'll help point you in the right direction.

question: What's the difference between PRFM Prime, Strong, and Capacity?
answer: These three programs follow different training philosophies, each with its own focus.
**PRFM Prime:** Our general strength and conditioning program, combining functional strength, fitness, and all-around physical performance.
**PRFM Strong:** Prioritizes strength development and muscle building.
**PRFM Capacity:** Focuses on cardiovascular fitness, conditioning, and building an engine that lasts.
All three follow structured, progressive programming. The best choice comes down to what you enjoy and what you're trying to achieve.

question: How does PRFM Custom coaching work?
answer: PRFM Custom is our premium, fully personalized coaching experience.
We start with an in-depth application and onboarding consultation to understand your goals, experience, training history, and individual needs.
From there, we build a program specifically for you.
We have experienced coaches across a range of disciplines, so whatever you're working toward, we'll help you develop a plan to get there.

Think of it as having a personal trainer in your pocket. Someone to keep you accountable, answer your questions, make adjustments, and check in regularly to make sure you're moving in the right direction.

question: Can I cancel my membership at any time?
answer: Absolutely. You're free to cancel your membership whenever you choose.
That said, we always encourage people to give their training time. Real progress doesn't happen overnight.
We've been coaching people online for over 10 years, and some of our clients have been training with us for almost a decade.
We think that says a lot about what happens when you find the right program and stick with it.
